![This Is Your Brain on Binaural Beats – Doctor Segil, Neurologist](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09251510-2042-0139-0000-acdac6ddec59:4)
Binaural beats are `an auditory illusion created when you listen to two slightly different sound frequencies in each ear` , which your brain perceives as a single pulsing third tone.[[1]](https://insighttimer.com/techniques/sound-healing/binaural-beats)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/V46C5WM8rjI)

### How They Work

- **Different Frequencies:** Your left ear hears one frequency (e.g., 400 Hz) and your right ear hears another (e.g., 410 Hz).
- **Perceived Beat:** Your brain processes the difference between them as a new beat (in this example, 10 Hz).
- **Brainwave Entrainment:** Listening to these tones through stereo headphones can encourage your [WebMD](https://www.webmd.com/balance/what-are-binaural-beats) brainwaves to synchronize with the frequency of the beat, a process detailed by resources like [Healthline](https://www.healthline.com/health/binaural-beats).[[1]](https://www.webmd.com/balance/what-are-binaural-beats)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/V46C5WM8rjI)[[3]](https://insighttimer.com/techniques/sound-healing/binaural-beats)[[4]](https://www.healthline.com/health/binaural-beats)

### Frequencies and Benefits

- **Delta (1–4 Hz):** Linked to deep sleep, physical recovery, and profound relaxation.
- **Theta (4–8 Hz):** Associated with light sleep, REM cycles, reduced anxiety, and deep meditation.
- **Alpha (8–13 Hz):** Thought to encourage a calm, focused, and positive mindset.
- **Beta (14–30 Hz):** Connected to high concentration, alertness, and active problem-solving.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ETQHHQpAdY4)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:7353082456795459456&ibp=oshop)

### How to Use Them

- **Wear Headphones:** You must use stereo headphones or earbuds so each ear receives a distinct frequency.
- **Match Your Goal:** Pick a frequency range that fits what you want to achieve, such as a focus track for studying or a delta track for sleeping.
- **Set the Volume:** Keep the audio at a comfortable, moderate background level while working or resting.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=acQS2Fef8tU)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ETQHHQpAdY4)[[3]](https://insighttimer.com/techniques/sound-healing/binaural-beats)
